floater.text: Drag gestures here from Inventory. Drag tiles to reorder; right-click to edit. Playing an inactive gesture activates it. Full gestures include their sound, animation and chat steps.
Use Add gestures… or drop Inventory gestures here. If you have no board, choose New board… first.
